request.title: HealthTech AI Pulse Orchestrator
request.prompt:
Run the HealthTech AI Pulse daily editorial workflow for today's Europe/Luxembourg editorial date in GadDev/healthtech-ai-pulse.

Resolve the current default-branch commit. At that same commit read docs/CONSTITUTION.md, docs/EDITORIAL.md, docs/editorial/ORCHESTRATOR.md and docs/editorial/DISCOVERY_V1.md. Follow the full operational procedure in ORCHESTRATOR.md and read all contracts, repository skills, schemas, validators and CI dependencies it names before classification or writes. Record that real contract_ref. Missing or inconsistent core dependencies block preparation; do not substitute external Pulse policies.

Execute the bounded discovery plan, preserve the full research ledger, verify selected claims, prepare surviving English stories and any declared imagery, create an issue only for surviving stories, and open/update the single canonical dated draft PR with exact-revision CI evidence. Preserve the five desks, current 75-point gate, two-story cap, source/evidence safeguards, safe ownership and recovery rules. No source or score is invented; unfinished research remains explicit. Do not manufacture output on quiet days.

Never change policy, schema, code, CI, deployment or task configuration from an editorial run. Never write batches to main, merge, enable auto-merge, mark a PR ready or duplicate a finalized date. Human review and merge remain mandatory. Report the actual operational outcome, counts, coverage gaps, CI state and recovery checkpoint using ORCHESTRATOR.md.
